data.description:
## Context
The construct sweep for dumbstruck-wonderful-xiphosuran found 103 test-local/helper `dict(os.environ)` subprocess mappings outside pytest fixture return values. They are not rendered on an unrelated later assertion, but a discriminating runtime probe proved that when the subprocess call itself raises, pytest long tracebacks render the subprocess `env` argument and expose an early synthetic sentinel; short traceback does not. Production/maintenance environment-propagation sites are a different product contract and are excluded.

## Plan
- Inventory the 103 executable test mappings and prioritize helpers whose tests deliberately exercise subprocess failure/timeout paths.
- Build a representative real-pytest RED oracle for the exception-time rendering carrier.
- For each live site, either minimize the subprocess environment, use an explicitly representation-safe boundary, or document a tested ambient-propagation exemption.
- Add a machine-checkable guard that prevents new unclassified broad test subprocess mappings.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every inventoried test subprocess mapping has a fixed or explicitly tested exemption disposition.
- [ ] Exception-time traceback probes contain no synthetic ambient sentinel for fixed sites.
- [ ] Intentional ambient-propagation tests retain their documented behavior.
- [ ] A repository gate detects new unclassified broad test subprocess mappings.
data.title: Audit test subprocess environments for exception-time credential rendering
